description: CTR by ranking position: the site's own historical Search Console clicks/impressions bucketed by position (1-3, 4-10, 11-20, 21+ — mirroring this codebase's existing rank-tracking position-distribution buckets), with the REAL clicks-weighted CTR this project achieved at each bucket. NEVER a fabricated industry-average CTR curve (the generic 'position 1 gets X% CTR' tables third-party vendors publish) — every figure is computed from this project's own archived Search Console history. Free and makes NO live Google call: reads only the archive `get_content_decay_report` also reads. ALWAYS narrow on `state` first: `not_connected` (connect a property), `no_data` (a property is bound but the archive has no rows at all for this dimension/window — an absence of data, NOT zero traffic), `analysed`.

dateRange.description: Convenience window over MisarSEO's own archive (default 'last_28_days'). No Google clamp applies — this never calls Google.

dimension.description: Bucket by query or page position (default 'query').

endDate.description: Explicit end date (YYYY-MM-DD). Use with startDate.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

startDate.description: Explicit start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Use with endDate.

name: get_gsc_ctr_by_position
